en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European spa town nestled among forested hills and fields. The town has a notable church with a tall spire in the left foreground and a compact cluster of villas and multi‑storey houses extending along a valley. The surrounding countryside is largely wooded with patches of farmland. At the bottom left of the image, the caption 'Bad Elster' is printed.
